periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The visible eye patch is oriented at a downward diagonal angle toward the muzzle, approximately 45 degrees from the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertically elongated oval shape where the height-to-width ratio is significantly greater than 1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering toward the lower-anterior edge, creating a tear-drop effect.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: The posterior edge of the dorsal band appears as a relatively flat, horizontal boundary across the upper back.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Broad band thickness covering approximately 40 to 50 percent of the visible torso height between the neck and mid-section.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Large lateral separation between the two pinnae, exceeding the width of a single ear region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior boundaries of the ears exhibit smooth, semicircular curvature.
